name: Lemon APANA node
summary: APANA node lemon.apana.org.au (originally arrakis.apana.org.au, which sold internet access), renamed lemon in 1995; merged with box.apana.org.au late 1995 to form South Australian Technologies (SATECH) (AUSTRALIAN PUBLIC ACCESS NETWORK ASSOCIATION INC., ABN 84 081 355 722).
